motivo: Se corrigieron las dos observaciones: 'Not 5...' ya no esta en el caption y el freezer ahora dice 'for soups and stews ... two to three months', que coincide con la Cold Food Storage Chart (FoodSafety.gov/USDA FSIS: soups and stews 2 a 3 meses en freezer, solo calidad) y con la tabla de freezing del FSIS. Todas las cifras (3-4 dias, 2 h / 1 h sobre 90 °F, 2-3 meses) y unidades (°F) coinciden con la fuente; no hay afirmaciones probables, dudosas ni falsas. Sugerencia menor, no bloqueante: la linea 'Sources' del caption cita solo Leftovers and Food Safety; conviene sumar 'Cold Food Storage Chart' ya que de ahi sale la cifra de 2-3 meses.

afirmaciones.texto: In part one, I told you not to let leftovers cool on the counter.
afirmaciones.fuente: Referencia al video propio (part 1); coherente con USDA FSIS (refrigerar dentro de 2 h).

afirmaciones.texto: Yes. The USDA says covering keeps moisture in and other fridge smells out.
afirmaciones.fuente: USDA FSIS, Leftovers and Food Safety: 'Cover leftovers, wrap them in airtight packaging, or seal them in storage containers. These practices help keep bacteria out, retain moisture, and prevent leftovers from picking up odors from other food in the refrigerator.' Tambien FSIS Refrigeration & Food Safety. https://www.fsis.usda.gov/food-safety/safe-food-handling-and-preparation/food-safety-basics/leftovers-and-food-safety

afirmaciones.texto: That chili has an expiration date. The USDA says three to four days in the fridge.
afirmaciones.fuente: USDA FSIS, Leftovers and Food Safety (3 to 4 days); Cold Food Storage Chart: soups and stews 3 a 4 dias. 'Expiration date' es licencia retorica.

afirmaciones.texto: Won't finish it? Freeze it. For soups and stews, the USDA says quality holds two to three months.
afirmaciones.fuente: Cold Food Storage Chart (FoodSafety.gov / USDA FSIS): soups and stews, 2 to 3 months en freezer; las pautas de freezer son solo de calidad. https://www.foodsafety.gov/food-safety-charts/cold-food-storage-charts

afirmaciones.texto: Heads up: that only counts if it's in the fridge within two hours, or one hour if it's over ninety degrees out.
afirmaciones.fuente: USDA FSIS, Leftovers and Food Safety / Danger Zone: 2 horas; 1 hora si supera 90 °F.
